command:
import sys,json,pathlib
sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1])
import minerva_blueprints
from minerva_blueprints.validation import validate
package=pathlib.Path(minerva_blueprints.__file__).resolve()
assert package.is_relative_to(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()),package
assert (package.parent/'schemas/minerva.schema.json').is_file()
root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]);result=validate(root/'docs/L2_MinervaBlueprints/blueprint.yaml',root)
print(json.dumps({'installed_package':str(package),'result':result},indent=2));raise SystemExit(result['exit_code'])

limits: Windows and Python 3.12.14 only; declared Python 3.11+ support is not all exercised here.
Wheel installed with --no-deps into a fresh target; dependencies already existed in the external environment.
Atlas tooling was invoked from the pinned sibling source checkout only for this review; it is not a Minerva runtime dependency or distributed reader.
The isolated copy used an external environment and working directory; no user deployment or remote publication occurred.
